# Agent Core

Agent Core is a self-hosted shared memory and capability service for AI agents.
It sits beside agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and custom runtimes.
It does not run, schedule, or replace those agents.

## What it provides

- Durable, scoped memory that agents can share across sessions and runtimes.
- Encrypted credential storage. Agents receive references instead of raw secrets.
- Connector bindings that run external API, MCP, adapter, and HTTP actions server-side.
- Scoped access, short-lived delegated authority, and an audit trail.
- Activity records and on-demand briefings for visible work and handoffs.

## Interfaces

- MCP at `/mcp` for agent tools.
- REST API for integrations and automation.
- Dashboard for setup, access control, connector bindings, and activity review.

## Product boundary

Agent Core is not an agent framework, agent runtime, coding assistant, scheduler,
or sandbox. An agent runtime decides what work to do. Agent Core holds the shared
state and controlled capabilities that the runtime uses.

## Data model and deployment

Agent Core is local-first and self-hosted. Memory, credentials, and configuration
live on the operator's disk. Connector calls leave the host only when an agent
explicitly runs a bound external action.
